architecture.query_normalization: Deterministic Unicode-Aware Procedural Normalization (Track A, 9 concept dictionaries)

overview_debiasing.rule: 0.85x score multiplier for introductory overview chunks ending in -HYB-000

justification: On DEV-24 (N=40), Strategy 1 achieved 90.0% Chunk Recall@5 (36/40) and 0.7581 MRR. Experimental strategies (dense fusion, dominant source gating, lexical entity anchoring) failed to achieve Pareto superiority: Dense Fusion caused severe regression on DEV24-CUT-05 (Rank 1 -> 8), Lexical Overlap degraded R@5 from 90.0% to 85.0%, and Dominant-Source Gating showed 0 net movement. In accordance with pre-registered protocol, no candidate was forced, and the frozen Gate 5.21 configuration remains unmodified.
